blocks.text: Photosynthesis roshni (light) ki tawanai (energy) istemal karti hai jo photosynthetic pigments jazb (absorb) kar ke kemiyai (chemical) tawanai mein badalte hain. Podon mein ise yun likha ja sakta hai: 6CO2 + 12H2O + roshni se C6H12O6 + 6O2 + 6H2O. Carbon dioxide, pani aur roshni reactants hain; glucose aur oxygen products. Pani dono taraf is liye hai ke kuch reactions mein yeh reactant ke taur par istemal hota hai aur doosron mein product ke taur par nikalta hai, magar pani ki koi khalis (net) paidawar nahin.

blocks.title: Yaad karen
blocks.text: Photosynthesis woh amal hai jis mein carbon ka kam-tawanai inorganic compound (CO2) reduce ho kar zyada-tawanai carbohydrates banata hai. Poday mili hui shamsi (solar) tawanai ka sirf 1 se 2 fisad kemiyai tawanai mein badalte hain, phir bhi yeh zameen ki taqreeban tamam zindagi ko qaim rakhne ke liye kafi hai.

blocks.title: Compensation point
blocks.text: Photosynthesis tanaffus (respiration) ki paidawar istemal karti hai aur tanaffus photosynthesis ki. Photosynthesis sirf din mein hoti hai, magar tanaffus din raat chalta hai. Subah aur shaam, jab roshni kam ho, photosynthesis aur tanaffus ki raftar thori der ke liye barabar ho sakti hai: photosynthesis ki chhori oxygen bilkul utni hoti hai jitni tanaffus ko chahiye, aur tanaffus ki chhori carbon dioxide utni jitni photosynthesis karne wale cells ko chahiye, to patton aur hawa ke darmiyan gases ka koi khalis tabadla nahin hota. Yeh compensation point hai. Dopahar ko photosynthesis tanaffus se aage nikal jati hai, to oxygen ki khalis paidawar aur carbon dioxide ka khalis jazb hota hai.
Roshni ka kirdar

Roshni woh tawanai deti hai jo saada molecules ko pecheeda (complex) organic compounds mein badalne wale kemiyai reactions chalati hai. Roshni ki tawanai chlorophyll jazb karta hai aur yeh kemiyai tawanai mein badal kar organic compounds mein C-H bonds ki tawanai ke taur par zakheera hoti hai.
Action spectrum

Photosynthetic pigments roshni ki mukhtalif taweel-mauj (wavelengths) ko mukhtalif raftar se jazb karte hain, aur mukhtalif wavelengths photosynthesis mein mukhtalif had tak moassar bhi hain. Har wavelength ki moassariyat action spectrum ke taur par maloom ki jati hai: poday ko ek ek kar ke roshni ke mukhtalif rang diye jate hain, aur har rang ke liye photosynthesis ki raftar patton se nikalne wali oxygen ki miqdar se napi jati hai; data ko action spectrum ke taur par graph kiya jata hai. Pehla action spectrum German biologist T. W. Engelmann ne 1883 mein Spirogyra ke photosynthetic pigments par kaam karte hue banaya. Jab filament ke cells ko mukhtalif wavelengths di gayin to sab se zyada photosynthesis neeli aur surkh roshni pane wale cells mein hui, is liye unhon ne sab se zyada oxygen chhori.
Carbon dioxide ka kirdar

Sugar CO2 ke reduction se ATP aur NADPH istemal kar ke banti hai, is liye CO2 sugars banane ke liye carbon ka zariya hai. Carbon dioxide stomata se patton mein dakhil hoti hai aur mesophyll cells ki cell walls ke jazb kiye pani mein hal ho jati hai. Patton mein stomata bari tadaad mein hote hain, aur CO2 ka dakhila un ke khulne par munhasir hai.

blocks.title: Photosynthesis kahan hoti hai
blocks.text: Kul photosynthesis ka taqreeban 10 fisad khushki ke poday karte hain; baqi samandaron, jheelon aur talabon mein hoti hai. Aabi (aquatic) photosynthetic jandar hal-shuda CO2, bicarbonates aur hal hone wale carbonates ko carbon ka zariya banate hain; khushki ke poday hawa ki CO2 istemal karte hain.
Pani ka kirdar

Pani photosynthesis ke dauran CO2 ke reduction ke liye hydrogen ka zariya hai. Photosynthesis mein nikalne wali oxygen pani se aati hai, is liye pani us hawa ki oxygen ka aham zariya hai jo zyada tar jandaron ko aerobic tanaffus ke liye chahiye. 1930 ki dahai mein Van Niel ne farz kiya ke poda hydrogen ke zariye ke taur par pani torta hai aur oxygen zaili paidawar ke taur par chhorta hai; us ka mafrooza un photosynthetic bacteria par mabni tha jo carbon dioxide se carbohydrate banate hain magar oxygen nahin chhorte. 1940 ki dahai mein oxygen ke isotopic tracer, 18O, ke tajurbe (experiment) se is ki tasdeeq hui.

blocks.alt: Gamlon mein podon ke do groups. Group 1 ko bhari-oxygen wala pani aur aam carbon dioxide milti hai aur woh bhari oxygen gas chhorta hai. Group 2 ko aam pani aur bhari-oxygen wali carbon dioxide milti hai aur woh aam oxygen gas chhorta hai.
blocks.caption: Bhari-oxygen ka tajurba: photosynthesis mein nikalne wali oxygen ka zariya pani hai (chapter ki Figure 5.3 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Scientists ne bhari oxygen wala pani aur bhari oxygen wali carbon dioxide tayyar ki. Jin podon ko bhari pani aur aam carbon dioxide di gayi unhon ne bhari oxygen chhori; jin ko bhari carbon dioxide aur aam pani diya gaya unhon ne aam oxygen chhori. Bhari isotope gas mein sirf tab aaya jab woh pani mein diya gaya tha, is liye photosynthesis ki chhori oxygen pani ke tootne se aati hai.

blocks.text: Photosynthesis mein pani toot kar hydrogen chhorta hai. Yeh hydrogen coenzyme nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate (NADP) ko reduce kar ke NADPH banata hai, aur reduce-shuda coenzyme NADPH CO2 ko reduce kar ke sugar banane ke liye reducing power ka kaam karta hai.
Photosynthetic pigments ka kirdar

Photosynthetic pigments thylakoid membranes mein hote hain, jahan yeh photosynthesis ke liye zaroori roshni ki tawanai pakarte hain. In mein chlorophyll a, chlorophyll b, xanthophylls aur carotenes shamil hain, aur mukhtalif pigments mukhtalif wavelengths (rangon) ki roshni jazb karte hain. Roshni photons naami zarraat (particles) ki dhaar ki tarah chalti hai, aur pigment ka molecule ek waqt mein ek photon jazb karta hai. Jab pigment ka molecule photon jazb karta hai to us ke electrons oonchi tawanai ki satah par chale jate hain, to woh tawanai se bharpoor, ya excited, ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Photon ki tawanai
blocks.text: Chhoti wavelength ke photons (neele) lambi wavelength (surkh) ke photons se zyada tawanai rakhte hain. Zyada tawanai wale photons electrons ko oonchi satahon tak le jate hain.
Chlorophylls

Chlorophyll ek lipid molecule hai. Chlorophyll a, b, c aur d podon aur algae mein milte hain, jabke baqi, bacteriochlorophylls, photosynthetic bacteria mein. Chlorophyll ke molecule ke do hisse hain, hydrophilic sar (head) aur hydrophobic dum (tail). Sar ek porphyrin ring hai jo chaar pyrrole rings (paanch-konon wale nitrogen wale compounds) se bani hai jinhen darmiyan mein ek magnesium atom jore rakhta hai; chlorophyll a mein doosri pyrrole ring par methyl (CH3) group hai, chlorophyll b mein usi jagah aldehyde (CHO) group. Porphyrin ring roshni jazb karti hai. Dum ek lambi hydrocarbon zanjeer hai jo molecule ko thylakoid membrane mein jamaye rakhti hai. Chlorophylls zyada tar banafshi-neeli aur narangi-surkh wavelengths jazb karte hain; sabz sab se kam jazb hoti hai aur guzar jati ya palat jati hai.

blocks.alt: Chlorophyll ka khaaka (schematic) molecule: narangi magnesium atom ke gird chaar sabz pyrrole rings porphyrin sar banati hain; ring II par ek box mein CH3 ya CHO likha hai; neeche lambi zigzag hydrocarbon dum latki hai.
blocks.caption: Chlorophyll molecule: porphyrin sar, magnesium markaz, aur woh group jo chlorophyll a aur b mein mukhtalif hai (chapter ki Figure 5.4 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Hydrophilic sar ek porphyrin ring hai jo chaar pyrrole rings, paanch-konon wali nitrogen wali rings, se bani hai jo markazi magnesium atom ke gird juri hain; yeh roshni jazb karta hai. Doosri pyrrole ring par chlorophyll a methyl group aur chlorophyll b aldehyde group rakhta hai. Hydrophobic dum lambi hydrocarbon zanjeer hai jo molecule ko thylakoid membrane mein jamati hai.

blocks.text: Accessory pigments

Accessory pigments chlorophyll a ke ilawa woh tamam pigments hain jo photosynthesis ke liye roshni jama karte hain. Chlorophyll b accessory pigment hai, aur baqi carotenoids (carotenes aur xanthophylls) aur phycobilins hain. Chlorophyll b aur carotenoids podon mein milte hain; phycobilins surkh algae aur cyanobacteria mein. Jab accessory pigments roshni jazb karte hain to woh tawanai chlorophyll a ki taraf aage barhate hain. Kuch wavelengths jo chlorophyll a jazb nahin karta chlorophyll b bohat moassar tareeqe se jazb karta hai aur is ke bar-aks, is liye dono mil kar roshni ki zyada chauri had jazb karte hain.

blocks.title: Carotenoids
blocks.text: Beta-carotene jaise carotenoids dohra kirdar ada karte hain: yeh spectrum ke neele aur sabz hisson mein roshni ki tawanai pakarte hain aur photosynthetic nizam ko zyada roshni ke nuqsan se bachate hain.
Absorption spectrum

Kisi pigment ki jazb ki hui mukhtalif wavelengths dikhane wala graph us ka absorption spectrum hai. Chlorophylls ka absorption spectrum dikhata hai ke neeli roshni (430 nm) aur surkh roshni (670 nm) ka jazb hona sab se zyada hai, jabke carotenoids ki jazb ki chotiyan mukhtalif hain. Photosynthesis ka action spectrum bhi dikhata hai ke neeli aur surkh roshni sab se moassar hain, is liye photosynthesis ka action spectrum photosynthetic pigments ke absorption spectrum se milta hai.

blocks.alt: 400 se 700 nm wavelength ke muqable mein do graphs jin ke axis ke saath rangon ki patti hai. Baen, absorption spectrum: chlorophyll a neele aur surkh mein chota chhoota hai, chlorophyll b un chotiyon ke zara andar, aur carotenoids neele-sabz mein. Daen, action spectrum: photosynthesis ki raftar neele aur surkh mein oonchi aur sabz mein neechi.
blocks.caption: (a) Pigments ka absorption spectrum aur (b) photosynthesis ka action spectrum (chapter ki Figure 5.5 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Chlorophylls sab se zyada neele mein taqreeban 430 nm aur surkh mein 670 nm par jazb karte hain aur sab se kam sabz mein; chlorophyll b ki chotiyan chlorophyll a ki chotiyon ke zara andar hain aur carotenoids neele-sabz mein jazb karte hain. Rang-ba-rang napi gayi photosynthesis ki raftar bhi neele aur surkh mein oonchi hai, is liye action spectrum absorption spectrum se milta hai, jaise Engelmann ne 1883 mein Spirogyra se pehli baar dikhaya.

blocks.text: Photosynthetic pigments ki tanzeem: photosystems

Shamsi tawanai ke moassar jazb aur istemal ke liye photosynthetic pigments photosystems naami jhundon (clusters) mein tarteeb-diye hote hain, jo chloroplasts ki thylakoid membranes mein jare hain. Photosystems mein photosynthetic pigments aur electron transport chain ke carriers hote hain. Har photosystem roshni jama karne wale antenna complex aur ek reaction centre par mushtamil hai. Antenna complex mein bohat se pigment molecules hain jo roshni ki tawanai pakarte hain aur excitation ki tawanai, high-energy electrons ki shakal mein, reaction centre ko dete hain. Reaction centre mein chlorophyll a ke ek ya zyada molecules hain jo high-energy electrons ek primary electron acceptor ko dete hain; acceptor unhen electron carriers ke silsile, electron transport chain, ko aage deta hai.

Chloroplast mein do photosystems hain, photosystem I (PS-I) aur photosystem II (PS-II), jin ke naam daryaft ki tarteeb se hain. PS-I ke reaction centre mein P700 chlorophyll a molecule hai aur yeh 700 nm ki roshni sab se behtar jazb karta hai; PS-II ke reaction centre mein P680 chlorophyll a hai jo 680 nm ki roshni sab se behtar jazb karta hai.

blocks.alt: Lambai mein kata baizavi chloroplast: sabz bahar ki membrane, halki intermembrane space, andar ki membrane aur halka sabz stroma. Andar chapti discs ke teen dher (grana) hain jo patli lamellae se jure hain, circular DNA ka jamni halqa aur chand narangi ribosomes.
blocks.caption: Chloroplast ki saakht (chapter ki Figure 5.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; wahi khaaka jo Chapter 3 mein hai).

blocks.alt: Cross-section mein thylakoid membrane. Peele roshni ke teer bohat se sabz aur narangi pigment nuqton ke antenna complex par girte hain; andar narangi teer tawanai ko P700 ya P680 chlorophyll a likhe jamni reaction centre ki taraf le jate hain, jo electrons narangi primary acceptor ko aur phir surmai carrier dairon ki zanjeer ko deta hai.
blocks.caption: Ek photosystem: antenna complex, reaction centre, primary acceptor aur electron transport chain (chapter ki Figure 5.7 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Photosystem thylakoid membrane mein jare pigments ka jhund hai. Antenna complex ke bohat se pigment molecules photons pakarte hain aur excitation ki tawanai andar reaction centre tak le jate hain, jahan chlorophyll a (PS-I mein P700, PS-II mein P680) high-energy electrons primary electron acceptor ko aur aage electron transport chain par deta hai.

blocks.text: Photosynthesis ka tareeqa (mechanism)

Photosynthesis ek redox (oxidation-reduction) amal hai. Jab pani ke molecules toot-te hain to woh oxidise hote hain, electrons aur hydrogen ions khote hain, aur oxygen dete hain; isi dauran CO2 reduce ho kar sugar banti hai jab us mein electrons aur hydrogen ions shamil hote hain. Oxidation aur reduction saath saath chalte hain. Yeh ek qadam ka amal nahin balke bohat se reactions ka pecheeda metabolic rasta hai. Roshni par munhasir (light-dependent) reactions grana ki thylakoid membranes par hote hain, aur roshni se azaad (light-independent) reactions chloroplast ke stroma mein.

blocks.alt: Chloroplast ke khaake mein do boxes. Sabz box, grana ke thylakoids mein light-dependent reactions, roshni aur pani leta hai aur oxygen chhorta hai. Narangi box, stroma mein light-independent reactions, carbon dioxide leta hai aur sugar deta hai. Un ke darmiyan teer ek taraf ATP aur NADPH aur wapas ADP, Pi aur NADP+ le jate hain.
blocks.caption: Chloroplast mein photosynthesis ka khulasa (chapter ki Figure 5.8 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Grana mein light-dependent reactions roshni jazb karte, pani torte, oxygen chhorte aur ATP aur NADPH banate hain. Stroma mein light-independent reactions us ATP aur NADPH se carbon dioxide ko sugar mein reduce karte aur ADP, Pi aur NADP+ grana ko wapas karte hain. Pani oxidise aur carbon dioxide reduce hoti hai, is liye photosynthesis redox amal hai.

blocks.text: 1. Light-dependent reactions

Light-dependent reactions ke aham waqiat yeh hain: photosynthetic pigments ka roshni ki tawanai jazb karna, us tawanai se electrons ka excited hona, aur ATP aur NADPH ka banna. ATP ka banna sab se aham qadam hai aur photophosphorylation kehlata hai; yeh non-cyclic ya cyclic hoti hai.

blocks.title: Reducing aur assimilating powers
blocks.text: Light-dependent reactions ke dauran roshni ki tawanai jazb ho kar kemiyai tawanai mein badalti hai, reducing aur assimilating powers, NADPH aur ATP, ki shakal mein. Light-independent reactions NADPH aur ATP se CO2 reduce karte hain aur yun kemiyai tawanai C-H bond ki tawanai ke taur par zakheera karte hain.
a) Non-cyclic photophosphorylation
Light-dependent reactions mein ATP banne ka yeh aam tareeqa hai. Dono photosystems hissa lete hain aur do electron chains shamil hoti hain.

items: PS-II ka roshni jazb karna: jab roshni PS-II par girti hai to us ke antenna ke chlorophyll molecules ki tawanai ki satah barhti hai. Do excited electrons un se nikal kar chlorophyll molecules ke darmiyan guzarte hue reaction centre ke P680 chlorophyll tak pohanchte hain. Is tawanai ke dhakke se P680 ke do excited electrons PS-II ke primary electron acceptor ko jate hain, jis se P680 mein ek electron ka khala (hole) banta hai, aur yeh ek taqatwar oxidising agent ban jata hai.

Pani ki photolysis: electron ka khala pani ke electrons se bharta hai. Jab pani ka molecule PS-II ke oxidise-shuda chlorophyll se reaction karta hai to woh do hydrogen ions, ek oxygen atom (jo foran doosre se mil kar O2 banata hai) aur do electrons mein toot-ta hai, jo P680 ka khala bharte hain. Pani torne ka yeh qadam photolysis hai.

PS-II se PS-I tak electron ka bahao: PS-II ke primary acceptor ko mile photoexcited electrons ab PS-II ki electron transport chain se PS-I tak jate hain, jis ke carriers plastoquinone (PQ), cytochrome complex aur plastocyanin (PC) hain. Chain se neeche utarte hue electrons ki tawanai kam hoti hai aur thylakoid membrane ise chemiosmosis se ATP banane mein istemal karti hai.

PS-I ka roshni jazb karna: PS-I ki jazb ki hui roshni ki tawanai us ke chlorophyll molecules ko bohat oonchi satah tak le jati hai; us ke reaction centre ke P700 chlorophyll ke excited electrons PS-I ke primary electron acceptor ko jate hain, aur PS-II se aane wale electrons P700 ka khala bharte hain.

PS-I se NADP+ tak electron ka bahao: PS-I ka primary acceptor photoexcited electrons doosri electron transport chain ko deta hai, jahan unhen ferredoxin (FD) leta hai. Enzyme NADP reductase unhen FD se NADP+ ko muntaqil karta hai; jab NADP+ ko do electrons aur ek H+ ion milte hain to yeh reduce ho kar NADPH banta hai, jo high-energy electrons zakheera karta hai.

blocks.alt: Electron ki tawanai ki satah ka graph. Neeche baen PS-II par roshni girti hai; electrons uchhal kar acceptor tak jate hain, PQ, cytochrome complex aur PC se neeche utarte hain (chemiosmosis se ATP bana kar) PS-I tak, PS-I ke roshni jazb karne par phir uchhalte hain, aur ferredoxin se guzar kar upar daen NADPH tak pohanchte hain. PS-II ke neeche pani ka box photolysis se electrons deta hai aur oxygen chhorta hai.
blocks.caption: Non-cyclic photophosphorylation: Z-scheme (chapter ki Figure 5.9 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Roshni PS-II mein P680 ko excite karti hai; us ke electrons primary acceptor ko jate hain aur khala pani ki photolysis ke electrons se bharta hai, jo oxygen chhorti hai. Electrons plastoquinone, cytochrome complex aur plastocyanin se utarte hain, aur jo tawanai khote hain thylakoid membrane us se chemiosmosis ke zariye ATP banati hai, phir PS-I ke P700 ka khala bharte hain. Roshni P700 ko excite karti hai, jis ke electrons PS-I ke acceptor, phir ferredoxin ko jate hain, aur NADP reductase un se NADP+ ko NADPH mein reduce karta hai. Electrons ka zigzag rasta Z-scheme hai.

blocks.text: Yun roshni ki tawanai ATP aur NADPH mein kemiyai tawanai mein badal jati hai. PS-II, PS-I aur electron transport chains se guzarne wale electrons ka zigzag rasta Z-scheme kehlata hai.

blocks.title: Hawa ki oxygen
blocks.text: Photolysis ke dauran banne wali oxygen hawa ki oxygen ka bunyadi zariya hai.
b) Cyclic photophosphorylation

Kuch halaat mein PS-I ke photoexcited electrons ek mutabadil rasta, cyclic electron flow, lete hain, jo PS-I istemal karta hai magar PS-II nahin. Electrons PS-I ke primary electron acceptor se electron transport chain ke zariye wapas P700 chlorophyll tak ghoom aate hain. NADPH nahin banta aur oxygen nahin nikalti, magar cyclic bahao ATP banata hai. Yeh tab hota hai jab Calvin cycle sust ho jaye aur chloroplast mein NADPH jama ho jaye.
Chemiosmosis

Light-dependent reactions ke dauran, jab electrons electron transport chain ke carriers ke silsile mein muntaqil hote hain, to oxidation aur reduction reactions hote hain: ek carrier electrons kho kar oxidise hota hai aur agla unhen pa kar reduce. Is carrier se carrier muntaqili mein electrons tawanai khote hain, aur chemiosmosis woh tareeqa hai jis se thylakoid membranes in redox reactions ko ATP banane se jorti hain.

Electrons se nikli tawanai H+ ions ke chloroplast ke stroma se thylakoid ke andaruni khane (lumen) mein active transport par kharch hoti hai, to bohat se H+ ions lumen mein jama ho jate hain. Yeh H+ gradient potential energy rakhta hai. H+ ions lumen se wapas stroma mein diffuse hote hain, zyada se kam concentration ki taraf, thylakoid membrane ke ek khaas protein, enzyme ATP synthase, se guzarte hue. Yeh enzyme H+ ions ke bahao se mili tawanai se ADP aur inorganic phosphate ke darmiyan bond banata hai, to ADP ATP mein badal jata hai aur tawanai us mein pack ho jati hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: cyclic photophosphorylation, jahan roshni PS-I ko excite karti hai, electrons acceptor tak uthte hain aur carriers ki zanjeer se wapas P700 tak ghoomte hain, raste mein ATP banate hue. Daen: PS-II, cytochrome complex, PS-I aur ATP synthase wali thylakoid membrane; surkh H+ ions neeche lumen mein pump hote hain aur ATP synthase se wapas upar behte hain, jo ADP aur Pi ko ATP banata hai.
blocks.caption: Cyclic photophosphorylation, aur thylakoid membrane ke paar chemiosmosis (chapter ki Figures 5.10 aur 5.11 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Cyclic bahao mein sirf PS-I kaam karta hai: us ke excited electrons primary acceptor se electron transport chain ke zariye P700 ko wapas aate hain, ATP banate hain magar NADPH nahin aur oxygen nahin; yeh tab hota hai jab Calvin cycle sust ho aur NADPH jama ho. Chemiosmosis mein chain par electrons ki khoi tawanai H+ ko stroma se thylakoid lumen mein pump karti hai; H+ gradient potential energy rakhta hai, aur jab H+ ATP synthase se wapas stroma mein diffuse hota hai to enzyme Pi ko ADP se jor kar ATP banata hai. Mitochondria bhi yehi tareeqa istemal karte hain.

blocks.text: 2. Light-independent reactions

Light-independent reactions chloroplast ke stroma mein reactions ka silsila hain jo CO2 se carbon, ATP se tawanai aur NADPH se hydrogen ions le kar tawanai se bharpoor sugar molecules banate hain. Inhen dark reactions bhi kehte hain, kyunke yeh roshni ki ghair-maujoodgi mein bhi aur maujoodgi mein bhi ho sakte hain jab tak ATP aur NADPH dastiyab hon. In ki tafseel Melvin Calvin aur un ke saathiyon ne University of California mein daryaft ki, is liye inhen Calvin cycle bhi kehte hain; Calvin ko is kaam par 1961 mein Nobel inaam mila. Calvin cycle ke teen marhale (phases) hain.
Marhala I: carbon fixation

Carbon fixation CO2 ka organic madde mein pehla shamil hona hai. Enzyme ribulose biphosphate carboxylase (rubisco, shayad zameen par sab se zyada paya jane wala protein) CO2 ke teen molecules ko paanch-carbon sugar ribulose biphosphate (RuBP) ke teen molecules se jorta hai. Is se teen-carbon compound 3-phosphoglyceric acid (3-PGA), ya 3-phosphoglycerate, ke chhe molecules bante hain. Kyunke pehle fixation ki paidawar teen-carbon compound hai, Calvin cycle ko C-3 rasta bhi kehte hain.
Marhala II: reduction

Chhe ATPs se chhe phosphate groups le kar 3-PGA ke molecules mein shamil kiye jate hain, to har 3-PGA 1,3-biphosphoglyceric acid banta hai. Phir har ek reduce ho kar glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate (G3P) banta hai, jis ke liye NADPH hydrogen deta hai, aur phosphate groups bhi alag hote hain. G3P ke chhe molecules bante hain, jin mein se ek cycle se nikal jata hai; yeh doosre G3P se mil kar glucose banata hai, jo phir doosre carbohydrates mein badal sakta hai.

blocks.title: Phir G3P
blocks.text: G3P wohi teen-carbon sugar hai jo glycolysis, cellular respiration ke pehle marhale, mein glucose ke tootne se banti hai.
Marhala III: RuBP ka dobara banna

Reactions ke ek silsile se G3P ke paanch molecules ribulose phosphate (RuP) ke teen molecules mein badalte hain. Har RuP mein ek phosphate group shamil kiya jata hai, light reactions ke teen ATPs istemal kar ke, jis se RuBP ke teen molecules bante hain. Yeh RuBP phir CO2 lete hain aur cycle chalta rehta hai.

blocks.alt: Teeron se jure chaar boxes ka cycle: upar teen RuBP teen CO2 le kar daen taraf chhe 3-PGA bante hain; yeh chhe ATP aur chhe NADPH se reduce ho kar neeche chhe G3P bante hain; ek G3P glucose banane nikal jata hai jabke paanch baen taraf teen RuP bante hain, jinhen teen ATP wapas RuBP banate hain.
blocks.caption: Calvin cycle teen marhalon mein (chapter ki Figure 5.12 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Marhala I, carbon fixation: rubisco teen CO2 ko teen paanch-carbon RuBP se jorta hai, jis se chhe teen-carbon 3-PGA bante hain. Marhala II, reduction: chhe ATP 3-PGA ko 1,3-biphosphoglyceric acid banate hain, jise chhe NADPH chhe G3P mein reduce karte hain; ek G3P cycle se nikalta hai aur aise do G3P ek glucose banate hain. Marhala III, dobara banna: paanch G3P teen RuP mein tarteeb pate hain, aur teen ATP unhen wapas teen RuBP banate hain taake phir CO2 len.

blocks.caption: Teen CO2 ke liye Calvin cycle ke inputs aur outputs
rows: 6 G3P (1 nikalta hai; 2 ek glucose banate hain)

blocks.prompt: Ek poda tez roshni mein rakha hai magar us ke stomata zabardasti band hain. Batayen ke reactions ka kaun sa set pehle rukta hai, kaun si paidawar jama hoti hai, aur chloroplast kis mutabadil electron raste par ja sakta hai.
blocks.explanation: CO2 na hone par stroma ka Calvin cycle pehle rukta hai, to ATP aur NADPH kharch nahin hote aur NADPH jama hota hai. Light reactions thori der chalte hain, aur chloroplast cyclic photophosphorylation par chala jata hai, jis mein PS-I ke electrons wapas P700 tak ghoomte hain aur ATP banta hai magar NADPH aur oxygen nahin.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: 6CO2 + 12H2O + roshni se C6H12O6 + 6O2 + 6H2O; ek redox amal jis mein pani oxidise aur CO2 reduce hoti hai. Roshni tawanai deti hai, CO2 carbon, aur pani hydrogen aur nikalne wali oxygen (bhari-oxygen tajurba; Van Niel).

Thylakoids ke pigments photons jazb karte hain: chlorophyll a (Mg wala porphyrin sar, hydrocarbon dum; ring II par CH3), chlorophyll b (CHO), accessory pigments ke taur par carotenoids aur phycobilins. Jazb ki chotiyan 430 aur 670 nm par; action spectrum is se milta hai (Engelmann, 1883).
Photosystems: antenna complex, reaction centre (PS-I mein P700, PS-II mein P680), primary acceptor, electron transport chain.

Non-cyclic photophosphorylation (Z-scheme): PS-II excited, pani ki photolysis P680 bharti aur O2 chhorti hai, electrons PQ, cytochrome complex, PC se utar kar chemiosmosis se ATP banate hain, PS-I excited, ferredoxin aur NADP reductase NADPH banate hain. Cyclic: sirf PS-I, sirf ATP.
Stroma mein Calvin cycle: rubisco se carbon fixation (3 CO2 + 3 RuBP se 6 3-PGA), 6 ATP aur 6 NADPH se 6 G3P mein reduction (ek glucose ke liye nikalta hai), 3 ATP se 3 RuBP ka dobara banna.
